digest.component_or_area: BindingStore baseline serialization and reconciler write guard
propositions: BindingStore.set_baseline unconditionally wrote baseline_advanced_at timestamp with no production reader, causing 1,144 writes to a baseline-unchanged 40-revision corpus and pathological git pack churn
set_baseline now guards baseline writes by comparing filtered baseline values for equality and returns early without reading clock or writing baseline_advanced_at when input equals stored state
Historical baseline_advanced_at keys in serialized bindings.json cache are inert and require no migration or reader in this change
Repeated reconciler passes over unchanged Jira state preserve byte-identical bindings.json and omit new commits via the centralized write guard
Baseline fields including None values round-trip correctly and changed baselines persist with updated serialized bytes
Packed-cost marginal per-version over frozen 40-SHA corpus decreased from 13.84 KiB to 2.33 KiB (16.8% of baseline, below 25% threshold)
